text:
That unforgettable instant

So empty returned by shadows

So empty rejected by clocks

That poor instant adopted by my tenderness

Naked naked of blood of wings

Without eyes to remember anxieties of old

Without lips to gather the juice of violences

lost in the song of the frozen bell towers.


Shelter it blind girl of soul

Put on it your hair frosted by fire

Embrace it little statue of terror.

Point out to it the convulsed world at your feet

At your feet where swallows die

Shivering with dread before the future

Tell it that the sighs of the sea

Moisten the only words

for which it is worth living.


But that sweaty instant of nothing

Crouched in the cave of destiny

Without hands to say never

Without hands to give butterflies

To dead children.

translation.title: Awaiting Darkness
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the capitalized, breathless sequence of imperatives and absences.
